falsification_condition: A re-measured term that changes any factor moves the ceiling, and the tests fail loudly by design. A corpus in which one-experience memory serves a materially larger share end to end would refute the 4.814% ceiling; a sequence of verified skills that stays correct under composition would refute the composition wall. If learning rate were shown to raise the end-to-end share, the answer NO would be wrong.

route_frontier.negative_search_summary: Two routes were refused on this tree's own measurement, not on taste. (1) RANK HARDER over the observed pool: contrast_selection_v1 is already exact and returned NO_INFORMATIVE_STATE with 8,388,600 survivors on the tree's real corpus, so the failure is population, not ordering. (2) INVENT A STATE FREELY: contrast_selection_v1 refuses to leave the observed pool for a measured reason (queries outside the generator's support), and certified_reached_escape_state_constructor_v2 exists precisely to bind any certified row to a separately supplied verifier; a state that cannot be reached is the wild guess the selector is right to refuse. The web adds the mechanism, not a dominator: observationally equivalent models need not agree under intervention because interventions create inputs that never occur in observational data (arXiv 2609.32247), and active interventional agents beat active observational ones only where a confounder is present (arXiv 1901.08162). Neither supplies a reachable-state constructor for THIS tree.
